1. Setup, File Existence Check, and Raster Stack Loading

```{r 01-load-covariates, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# CHUNK 1: ENVIRONMENT SETUP & RASTER COVARIATE IMPORT
# ==============================================================================

library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# Set base path for covariates
cov_dir <- "C:/Users/eldayit/OneDrive - University of Maryland/Desktop/All files/Ventures/Pangolins_Gabon/Input/Objective_2"

# Explicit covariate filenames
cov_files <- c(
  "B_distance_to_Forest_Concessions.tif",
  "B_distance_to_InternationalGabonBorders.tif",
  "B_distance_to_MajorGabonCities.tif",
  "B_distance_to_majorRoads.tif",
  "B_distance_to_ProtectedAreas.tif",
  "B_distance_to_waterways.tif",
  "B_LAI_2024.tif",
  "B_Population_2020.tif",
  "B_SRTM_2000.tif"
)

# Construct full paths and verify file existence
cov_paths <- file.path(cov_dir, cov_files)
missing_files <- cov_paths[!file.exists(cov_paths)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("The following raster files were not found:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}

# Load rasters into SpatRaster stack and clean layer names
covariates_raw <- rast(cov_paths)
names(covariates_raw) <- gsub("\\.tif$", "", cov_files)

cat("Chunk 1 Complete: All 9 raw raster covariates successfully imported.\n")

```

2. Spatial Coherence Check, Resampling Alignment, & Composite Index

```{r 02-align-and-composite, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# CHUNK 2: SPATIAL ALIGNMENT & COMPOSITE COVARIATE CALCULATIONS
# ==============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)

# 1. Align all rasters to the template (first layer) geometry
template_raster <- covariates_raw[[1]]
aligned_list    <- list()

for (i in 1:nlyr(covariates_raw)) {
  lyr <- covariates_raw[[i]]
  if (!compareGeom(template_raster, lyr, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    lyr <- resample(lyr, template_raster, method = "bilinear")
  }
  aligned_list[[i]] <- lyr
}

covariates <- rast(aligned_list)

# 2. Compute anthropogenic composite accessibility index
covariates$B_city_road_composite <- covariates[["B_distance_to_MajorGabonCities"]] + 
                                    covariates[["B_distance_to_majorRoads"]]

# 3. Visualize component vs. composite accessibility covariates
accessibility_stack <- subset(
  covariates, 
  c("B_distance_to_MajorGabonCities", 
    "B_distance_to_majorRoads", 
    "B_city_road_composite")
)

ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = accessibility_stack) +
  facet_wrap(~lyr, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option   = "magma", 
    name     = "Distance (m)", 
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Anthropogenic Accessibility Covariates (Gabon)",
    subtitle = "Individual Components vs. Composite Accessibility Index"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text   = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```

3. Complete Random Forest Modeling & Spatial Prediction Pipeline Function

```{r 03-rf-pipeline-function, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# CHUNK 3: RANDOM FOREST MODEL EVALUATION & FEATURE IMPORTANCE FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================

library(ranger)
library(pROC)
library(spdep)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)

# Clean, publication-ready variable lookup labels
variable_labels <- c(
  "B_distance_to_MajorGabonCities"          = "Dist. major cities",
  "B_city_road_composite"                 = "Composite dist. major cities & roads",
  "B_distance_to_InternationalGabonBorders" = "Dist. international borders",
  "B_distance_to_majorRoads"              = "Dist. major roads",
  "B_distance_to_Forest_Concessions"      = "Dist. forest concessions",
  "B_LAI_2024"                            = "Leaf area index",
  "B_Population_2020"                     = "Population density",
  "B_SRTM_2000"                           = "Elevation",
  "B_distance_to_ProtectedAreas"          = "Dist. protected areas",
  "B_distance_to_waterways"               = "Dist. waterways"
)

# Define output directory for saving plots
output_dir <- "C:/Users/eldayit/OneDrive - University of Maryland/Desktop/All files/Ventures/Pangolins_Gabon/Output/Objective_2"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)


#' Run Random Forest Evaluation & Feature Importance for a Given Crime Stage
run_crime_stage_rf <- function(stage_path, stage_name, covariates_stack) {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Load Presences & Extract Environmental Values
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  pts <- st_read(stage_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% 
    st_transform(crs(covariates_stack))
  
  pres_env   <- terra::extract(covariates_stack, pts, ID = FALSE)
  valid_pres <- complete.cases(pres_env)
  
  pres_df   <- data.frame(presence = 1, pres_env[valid_pres, ])
  pts_valid <- pts[valid_pres, ]
  n_pres    <- nrow(pres_df)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Sample Sampling-Bias Weighted Background Points (2:1 Ratio)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  road_dist    <- covariates_stack[["B_distance_to_majorRoads"]]
  bias_surface <- exp(-0.0001 * road_dist)
  
  set.seed(42)
  bg_coords <- terra::spatSample(
    bias_surface, 
    size   = n_pres * 2, 
    method = "weights", 
    xy     = TRUE, 
    na.rm  = TRUE
  )
  
  bg_pts   <- st_as_sf(as.data.frame(bg_coords), coords = c("x", "y"), crs = crs(covariates_stack))
  bg_env   <- terra::extract(covariates_stack, bg_pts, ID = FALSE)
  valid_bg <- complete.cases(bg_env)
  
  bg_df        <- data.frame(presence = 0, bg_env[valid_bg, ])
  bg_pts_valid <- bg_pts[valid_bg, ]
  
  # Combine presence and background datasets
  df          <- rbind(pres_df, bg_df)
  df$presence <- as.factor(df$presence)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Train/Test Split (70/30) & Random Forest Fitting
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  set.seed(123)
  train_idx  <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), size = 0.70 * nrow(df))
  train_data <- df[train_idx, ]
  test_data  <- df[-train_idx, ]
  
  rf_model <- ranger(
    formula     = presence ~ .,
    data        = train_data,
    probability = TRUE,
    num.trees   = 700,
    importance  = "permutation"
  )
  
  # Evaluate Test AUC
  test_preds <- predict(rf_model, data = test_data)$predictions[, "1"]
  roc_obj    <- roc(test_data$presence, test_preds, quiet = TRUE)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Residual Spatial Autocorrelation (Moran's I)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  full_preds    <- predict(rf_model, data = df)$predictions[, "1"]
  obs_numeric   <- as.numeric(as.character(df$presence))
  residuals_vec <- obs_numeric - full_preds
  
  all_geom   <- c(st_geometry(pts_valid), st_geometry(bg_pts_valid))
  coords_mat <- st_coordinates(all_geom)
  
  nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords_mat, k = 8))
  lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
  
  moran_res <- moran.test(residuals_vec, lw)
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Print Goodness of Fit & Performance Summary
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("MODEL EVALUATION SUMMARY:", stage_name, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("Sample Sizes   : %d Presences | %d Background Points\n", n_pres, nrow(bg_df)))
  cat(sprintf("Test AUC Score : %.4f\n", auc(roc_obj)))
  cat(sprintf("OOB Error Rate : %.4f\n", rf_model$prediction.error))
  cat(sprintf("Moran's I (Res): %.4f (p-value: %.4f)\n", 
              moran_res$estimate[["Moran I statistic"]], moran_res$p.value))
  cat("============================================================\n\n")

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Publication-Ready Feature Importance Plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  imp_scores <- importance(rf_model)
  imp_df <- data.frame(
    Variable   = names(imp_scores),
    Importance = as.numeric(imp_scores)
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))
  
  p_imp <- ggplot(imp_df, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), y = Importance)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2b5c8f", width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("%.2f%%", Importance * 100)),
      hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = variable_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max(imp_df$Importance) * 1.25),
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Feature Importance - ", stage_name),
      x     = "Predictor Variables",
      y     = "Mean Decrease in Accuracy (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.text        = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black")
    )
  
  # Display plot in R Markdown output
  print(p_imp)
  
  # Save Importance Plot PNG
  clean_stage_id <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", stage_name)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Feature_Importance_", clean_stage_id, ".png")),
    plot     = p_imp,
    width    = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  
  return(list(
    model      = rf_model, 
    roc        = roc_obj, 
    moran      = moran_res, 
    importance = imp_df
  ))
}
```

4. EXECUTE MODELING PIPELINE FOR ALL CRIME STAGES

```{r 04-run-all-stages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# CHUNK 4: EXECUTE MODELING EVALUATION & IMPORTANCE FOR ALL STAGES
# ==============================================================================

input_dir_obj3 <- "C:/Users/eldayit/OneDrive - University of Maryland/Desktop/All files/Ventures/Pangolins_Gabon/Input/Objective_3"

# Stage I (Pre-Activity)
stage1_results <- run_crime_stage_rf(
  stage_path       = file.path(input_dir_obj3, "Crime_stage_I.gpkg"),
  stage_name       = "Stage I (Pre-Activity)",
  covariates_stack = covariates
)

# Stage II (Activity)
stage2_results <- run_crime_stage_rf(
  stage_path       = file.path(input_dir_obj3, "Crime_stage_II.gpkg"),
  stage_name       = "Stage II (Activity)",
  covariates_stack = covariates
)

# Stage III (Post-Activity)
stage3_results <- run_crime_stage_rf(
  stage_path       = file.path(input_dir_obj3, "Crime_stage_III.gpkg"),

  covariates_stack = covariates
)
```
